correctness.rationale: The 20 vertices and 30 edges are explicitly defined; independent programs implement equivalent vertex-closure and edge-observation monitoring models on explicitly verified isomorphic graphs. All 211 subtriple candidates and 1,140 triples were exhaustively assessed; the explicit 240-element S5 x C2 automorphism subgroup partitions the latter into 12 listed orbits, exactly two successful, 120 each. Both complete state graphs were constructed with precisely stated moves; from orbit representatives complete BFS distance histograms sum to 240 and give eccentricities, with the second program checking all 240 eccentricities independently. No infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The exact classification resolves which three sites optimally monitor a canonical highly symmetric cubic incidence graph, distinguishing all 240 choices by intrinsic pairwise graph distances. The two types have rigorously different synchronous observation speeds, swap-neighborhood sizes and TS eccentricities, a concrete speed-versus-relocation tradeoff not implied by the optimum cardinality. Full TS and TJ graph metrics give natural algorithmic benchmarks for maintaining optimal PMU placement; these are motivated exact invariants, not arbitrary parameter slices.
